strings.zh: 这里是以精灵竞技的现在以及{NEWLINE}精灵和人类的{CLEAR}信任之心为主题的,{SCROLL}被称为「信赖」的房间。
strings.en: This is the “Trust” room.{SCROLL}It is to show the mutual reliance{NEWLINE}between Pokémon and people.

strings.zh: 这之后是要用同一个精灵{NEWLINE}取得５枚奖章！{CLEAR}只有优秀的口袋竞技员{CLEAR}才被允许进入。

strings.zh: 这个圆顶里,{NEWLINE}有着许多会场呢！

strings.zh: 装饰有写着{NEWLINE}自己签名的运动衫！

strings.zh: 交换次数达到２００次的人,{SCROLL}和朋友一起协力合作,{NEWLINE}在此为其深刻的羁绊鼓掌。

strings.en: Pokéathlon Medals...{SCROLL}Those are the proof of the hard work{NEWLINE}of both Pokéathletes and Pokémon.{SCROLL}Those Pokémon that have won all five{NEWLINE}Medals are called “Medalist Pokémon”{CLEAR}to commemorate the trust they’ve{CLEAR}earned from their Pokéathlete.
